cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this ANC SHARP video on the Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎收看這支介紹 Microsoft Agent Framework 的 C# AI 影片。

cues.en: Today we're going to look into a unique feature that Google Gemini have, and that is integration into Google Maps.
cues.zh: 今天要看 Google Gemini 獨有的功能：整合 Google Maps。

cues.en: I haven't seen any of the others have any maps integration, but since Google owns Google Maps, of course, you have the option to actually integrate into it.
cues.zh: 我還沒看過其他供應商有地圖整合；Google 擁有 Google Maps，當然就能提供這個功能。

cues.en: So let's see that in action.
cues.zh: 實際看看。

cues.en: So here I am in a sample, and that sample being the Google Gemini specific features and Google Maps.
cues.zh: 這裡是 Google Gemini 專屬功能底下的 Google Maps 範例。

cues.en: And we make a Google Gen AI client as normal with Google, and turn it into an agent like we do.
cues.zh: 像平常一樣建立 Google GenAI Client，再轉成代理程式。

cues.en: Normally we set tools using the normal tools and AI tools, and AI function factory, and so on.
cues.zh: 一般會透過 Tools、AITool 與 AIFunctionFactory 加入工具。

cues.en: But these tools are very special to Google, so we need to go in and do what is called breaking glass.
cues.zh: 但這個工具是 Google 專屬，因此要進入底層的原生設定。

cues.en: So inside the chat client agent options and chat options, we need to set the raw representation factory.
cues.zh: 在 ChatClientAgentOptions 的 ChatOptions 中，指定 RawRepresentationFactory。

cues.en: And if we do that to generate content config, we get access to some other tools, not AI tools, but the Google tools.
cues.zh: 建立 GenerateContentConfig 後，就能使用 Google 原生工具，而不是 AITool。

cues.en: And then among those tools, we can make a tool called Google Maps.
cues.zh: 其中可以建立一個 GoogleMaps 工具。

cues.en: We have very few options here, but among one thing, we can enable a widget.
cues.zh: 這裡的選項不多，但可以啟用 Widget。

cues.en: We'll talk a little more about what those are at some point.
cues.zh: 稍後會解釋它是什麼。

cues.en: But if you do this, and let's just run it to here, we can then ask a question, for example, like,
cues.zh: 先執行到這裡，再提出問題，例如，

cues.en: what is the opening times of Hard Rock Cafe in New York?
cues.zh: 「紐約 Hard Rock Cafe 的營業時間是什麼？」

cues.en: And tell me if it's wheelchair access.
cues.zh: 「另外告訴我是否方便輪椅進出。」

cues.en: So if we do this, it will go off and talk with Google Maps.
cues.zh: 它就會查詢 Google Maps。

cues.en: And once it comes back,
cues.zh: 回覆之後，

cues.en: we can see we get a response back.
cues.zh: 可以看到取得了答案。

cues.en: Let me make this a little bit bigger so we can see.
cues.zh: 把畫面放大一點。

cues.en: So it talks about Hard Rock Cafe at Times Square, where it's located, the opening hours, and how the wheelchair access is.
cues.zh: 它介紹時報廣場的 Hard Rock Cafe，包括地址、營業時間與輪椅無障礙資訊。

cues.en: Apparently, there's two of them. I didn't actually know, but fair enough.
cues.zh: 原來有兩個地點，我之前也不知道。

cues.en: So what we can do in order to actually look a bit more into this, instead of just what is being shown here,
cues.zh: 除了這裡顯示的文字，還能進一步查看資料，

cues.en: which has been taken out of the response, is we can go in and take our response, get the raw representation factor of that,
cues.zh: 先從回覆取得 RawRepresentation，

cues.en: which is a chat response, still Microsoft.
cues.zh: 這一層仍是 Microsoft 的 ChatResponse。

cues.en: But if we go in and take the raw representation of that, we get back to the generate content response, so the output of this.
cues.zh: 再取出它的 RawRepresentation，就會得到 GenerateContentResponse，也就是 Google 的原始輸出。

cues.en: And once we have that, we can go to something called Candidates.
cues.zh: 有了這個物件，就能查看 Candidates。

cues.en: And inside the Candidates, there's only one in this case, we can get grounding metadata.
cues.zh: 這次只有一個 Candidate，其中有 GroundingMetadata。

cues.en: So if we get that metadata, we can get what is called the Google Maps Widget Context Token.
cues.zh: 從 metadata 可以取得 GoogleMapsWidgetContextToken。

cues.en: I haven't tried this out in real life, but according to the documentation, you can use this token together with their JavaScript API
cues.zh: 我還沒實際測試，但根據文件，能搭配 Google 的 JavaScript API 使用這個 Token，

cues.en: to get something that looks a little like this in your AI application, if you wish to.
cues.zh: 在 AI 應用程式裡顯示類似這樣的地圖元件。

cues.en: Alternative, you can go in and get all the grounding chunks, meaning that in this case, we have two grounding chunks,
cues.zh: 另外也能取得所有 GroundingChunks；這次有兩個，

cues.en: one being for each of the two Hard Rock Cafes.
cues.zh: 分別對應兩家 Hard Rock Cafe。

cues.en: And if we go through each of them, we get a URL to Google Maps, so we could go to this URL. Let's do that.
cues.zh: 逐一查看，每筆都有 Google Maps 網址；我們直接打開。

cues.en: And we will see that we get to Hard Rock Cafe in Google Maps.
cues.zh: 就會前往 Google Maps 上的 Hard Rock Cafe。

cues.en: So we can get links to the thing, and we can get a title, which is just the Hard Rock Cafe.
cues.zh: 所以能取得地點連結，以及 Hard Rock Cafe 這個標題。

cues.en: And we can get a bunch of extra information about that specific location.
cues.zh: 也能取得很多與該地點有關的額外資訊。

cues.en: And we are talking really lots, type, restaurant, business, price level.
cues.zh: 真的很多，包括類型、餐廳、商家與價位等。

cues.en: All the things you find in Google normally is also here, including the wheelchair access,
cues.zh: 一般在 Google 查得到的資料，這裡也有，包括輪椅無障礙資訊，

cues.en: and that's the reason why they were able to give us back that information.
cues.zh: 這也是模型能回答剛才問題的原因。

cues.en: And then there would be one more, and one more, and so on.
cues.zh: 之後還會有下一筆、再下一筆。

cues.en: And for each of these, you can see these small one and two, that is just referencing each of these grounding chunks,
cues.zh: 回覆中的小編號一與二，就是對應各個 GroundingChunk，

cues.en: so you can link the data to the grounding chunk.
cues.zh: 因此可以把文字資訊與來源資料連結起來。

cues.en: But if we do it like this, it will give us back all this extra information if we wish to also show that to the user in some way.
cues.zh: 如果也想以其他方式呈現給使用者，就能取得這些額外資料。

cues.en: It only comes back in this format, it's not in a structured format, unfortunately, but it's still better than nothing that we have all this information.
cues.zh: 可惜部分內容不是完整的結構化格式，但至少仍然有資訊可以使用。

cues.en: And once we have gone through that, getting the second Hard Rock Cafe here, and all its information.
cues.zh: 接著也能取得第二家 Hard Rock Cafe，以及它的相關資料。

cues.en: So if there's only one result, you only get one of these, if there's multiple results, you get multiple of these.
cues.zh: 只有一個結果，就只有一筆；有多個結果，就會有多筆。

cues.en: A little about pricing of this, it's actually the same as the web search, you get 5,000 prompts for free, and then $14 per 1,000 queries.
cues.zh: 價格方面與網頁搜尋相同，前五千個提示詞免費，之後每一千個查詢十四美元。

cues.en: So it's a really cool way if you have something that needs to integrate with restaurants, with sightseeing and such things in the system.
cues.zh: 如果系統需要整合餐廳、觀光景點等資訊，這是相當實用的方法。

cues.en: So that's everything, see you on the next one.
cues.zh: 以上就是全部內容，我們下支影片見。
